title: Aspirin and Reye's syndrome
text: Aspirin should not be given to children or teenagers recovering from a viral infection such as influenza or chickenpox, due to the risk of Reye's syndrome. Source: CDC.

title: Penicillin allergy
text: Patients with a documented severe penicillin allergy should avoid other beta-lactam antibiotics unless cross-reactivity has been formally evaluated. Source: clinical allergy guideline.

title: ACE inhibitors in pregnancy
text: ACE inhibitor blood pressure drugs such as lisinopril are contraindicated in pregnancy, because they can cause fetal injury, especially in the second and third trimesters. Source: FDA label.

title: Influenza vaccination
text: An annual influenza vaccine is recommended for everyone aged 6 months and older, with rare exceptions. Source: CDC ACIP recommendations.
